caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware container with a slightly bulging midsection and a fitted lid on top. The object appears to be a water cooler or dispenser, as indicated by the presence of a metal spigot at the lower front. The surface of the container is a beige or light gray color, with two distinct decorative blue floral motifs on both the upper and lower sections. Both blue designs feature stylized leaves and dot patterns. Some small, dark text is visible above both floral motifs, though it is not clearly legible. The lid, which sits flush atop the container, has a central recessed portion and is coloured similarly to the body with a slightly darker, brownish tint in the middle. The background of the image is plain and light, with no additional objects or scenery present. The artist's signature, "N. Amantea," is present in the lower right corner.
title: Water Filter and Cooler
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
